note: One lead per moment; handoffs are crossfades. 1 bar = 1.0 s, so a bar number equals its start time in seconds.

sections.intent: The windmill man alone, turning his wheel in a slow circle: patient, remembering.
The phonogram's gears and the boy at the door: clockwork lilt, curiosity.
The story swelling: fury and grief together.
The wind rising, the wheel spinning faster than hands can hold.
THE STORM takes the stage alone: full force, finally at true pitch.
The drained well: near-stillness, one slow figure in the dark.
The man at the wheel again: same circle, but the dancer knows the top note now.

events.what: Second string statement begins: the B-flat turns arrive (B-flat bars at 70 s and 78 s)
Orchestra melody enters (terraced entries before this: basses/tuba 82, trombones 84, horns + tremolo rain 86)
Timpani: statement-final bar, roll into the held breath
Held breath: tutti D minor held one extra bar, released at 107.0
Storm gathering: riser + hats on beats 2-3 (no kick), gap on 111 beat 3
DROP + the one thunder hit (low, tuned near D); kick + sub on beat 1 of every bar
FIRST TRUE F5 in the piece (doubled at the octave): the climax
Last kick; the sub carries over into the well
Piano return, pp, at true pitch (F5 at 152.5 s and 160.5 s, softly)
Held D minor (no Picardy third), rings out to the end
